title: Research
description: Roles for sourced research in Markdown, and a fact-check gate that checks each claim has a source.

roles.title: Researcher
roles.description: Writes findings as Markdown, every claim with a source link and date.

roles.title: Fact-checker
roles.description: Checks each claim in the changed Markdown against its source.

gates.focus: Every factual claim in the changed Markdown has a link that supports it. Unsupported or misattributed claims are major.
